title: Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation First Counted Day, TRICARE Reserve Select
content:
**Desk guidance - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select, Reserve Select closing reconciliation.**

Whether the day a bill is counted from is itself counted follows the application for that active duty enrollment: where the bill is counted from the enrollment's effective date or from the first day it covers and the enrollment was applied for on or before that day, that day is the first day counted; where it is counted from either of those days and the enrollment was applied for after that day, the first day counted is the day after the application date; otherwise the first day counted is the day after the day the bill is counted from.

The application date is the date the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment was applied for, as its record shows. The counted days of a bill run from its first counted day through the last day of its month.

| Bill counted from (hypothetical) | Applied for | First day counted |
|---|---|---|
| 24 June, the effective date | 20 June | 24 June |
| 24 June, the effective date | 26 June | 27 June |
| 1 July, the first day the bill covers | 30 June | 1 July |
| 1 July, the first day the bill covers | 2 July | 3 July |
| 14 June, the plan's termination date | any date | 15 June |
